confirm.title: CloudBBQ Thermometer
confirm.description:
Set up {name} ({address})?

Home Assistant will connect to it every 15 seconds to read the probe temperatures.

abort.already_configured: This thermometer is already set up.
abort.no_devices_found: No new CloudBBQ thermometer found. If yours is already set up, it will not be listed here — check Devices & Services. Otherwise switch it on and make sure it is in range of a Bluetooth adapter that supports connections (Shelly proxies forward advertisements only).
abort.not_supported: This device advertises the FFF0 service but does not look like an iBBQ thermometer.

init.title: CloudBBQ Thermometer
init.description: How many probe sockets does this unit have? The device always reports six, but entities are only created for the sockets you actually have.
